_readme: Public addresses only (no keys, no seeds, no emails). The secret side lives in funding/.secrets/wallets.json, which no AI session reads. Fill each address after you create the wallet; drafts and pages point here for custody status.

wallets.label: pink-paw-receiving
wallets.notes: same value as campaign.json shelter.wallet and PROOF_SHELTER; replace with the shelter's own key at handover and re-register on-chain

wallets.label: shelter-split-treasury
wallets.role: SHELTERSPLIT_TREASURY: receives the remainder and rounding dust

wallets.label: deployer
wallets.role: keystore tokentails: deploys ShelterSplit and DonateRouter (FUND_KEYSTORE) and is the one wallet the person funds; distribute-mainnet.sh tops up the hot wallet and the agent from it; never the hot wallet

wallets.label: donate-hot-wallet
wallets.role: keystore donatehot = SHELTER_DONATE_PRIVATE_KEY on the backend: pays sponsored treats from a small float (funding-plan.json), topped up from the deployer by distribute-mainnet.sh

wallets.label: agent-wallet
wallets.role: keystore agent: the Tameion / x402 demo agent, topped up from the deployer by distribute-mainnet.sh

wallets.label: arc-grant-receiver
wallets.role: receives the Arc Microgrant (USDC on Arc)

wallets.label: colosseum-team-leader
wallets.role: Colosseum prize payee, in the Team Leader's own name

wallets.label: testnet-shelter-split-treasury
wallets.role: treasury() of every testnet ShelterSplit (read on-chain 2026-10-04)

wallets.label: testnet-donate-hot-wallet
wallets.role: keystore donatehot: SHELTER_DONATE_PRIVATE_KEY of the local testnet backend (treats, relay gas)

wallets.label: testnet-deployer
wallets.role: keystore tokentails: deploys the testnet ShelterSplits and DonateRouters
